title: Episode 50
logline: Following their illicit passion in the abandoned manor wing, Catherine negotiates Father Thomas's corrupt silence with territorial control—unaware that Agnes has walked in and witnessed their scandalous intimacy.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 49, where Father Thomas and Catherine sealed their covert alliance in the secluded wing; now, their secret affair deepens into political extortion before being shattered by an unexpected witness.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Playful, Seductive):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:01.80) | End: (00:05.80)
"A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas."

Start: (00:05.80) | End: (00:07.20)
Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.

blocks.camera:

blocks.speaker: FATHER THOMAS (Low, Ironical):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:07.20) | End: (00:11.20)
"A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."

Start: (00:11.80) | End: (00:15.80)
Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:11.80) | End: (00:15.80)
Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Intense, Whispering):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:12.00) | End: (00:15.50)
"Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."

Start: (00:15.80) | End: (00:18.80)
Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:15.80) | End: (00:18.80)
Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:16.80) | End: (00:18.50)
"Name your price."

Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:26.50)
Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:18.80) | End: (00:26.50)
Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.

blocks.speaker: FATHER THOMAS (Calculated, Demanding):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:19.40) | End: (00:25.00)
"The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."

Start: (00:26.50) | End: (00:30.50)
Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:26.50) | End: (00:30.50)
Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:27.20) | End: (00:30.20)
"That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."

Start: (00:30.50) | End: (00:35.80)
Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:30.50) | End: (00:35.80)

blocks.speaker: FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:35.00)
"Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."

Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:39.80)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:39.80)
Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:36.50) | End: (00:39.40)
"Unsupervised. In your hands alone."

Start: (00:39.80) | End: (00:43.00)
Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:39.80) | End: (00:43.00)
Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.

blocks.speaker: FATHER THOMAS (Grave):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:40.40) | End: (00:42.50)
"For as long as it holds."

Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:48.50)
Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:48.50)
Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Softly, Teasing):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:43.20) | End: (00:48.00)
"Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does."

Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:54.50)
Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:54.50)
Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.

blocks.speaker: FATHER THOMAS (Chuckle, Resigned):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:49.80) | End: (00:54.00)
"I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again."

Start: (00:54.50) | End: (00:59.80)
Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:54.50) | End: (00:59.80)
Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Murmuring):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:54.80) | End: (00:56.50)
"In another room no one uses?"

blocks.speaker: FATHER THOMAS (Whispering):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (00:59.20)
"Perhaps I like rooms no one uses."

Start: (00:59.80) | End: (01:05.50)
Close-up profile as Catherine slides both hands into the dark hair at the back of his neck, pulling him closer.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:59.80) | End: (01:05.50)

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Low, Carnal):

"Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for."
